description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

UnitedHealth Group is hiring a Software Engineer - AI & Security Technology to build and support software, AI, automation, integrations, and analytics that enhance physical corporate security operations. The role also supports enterprise security platforms, databases, servers, and cloud services, and troubleshoots production issues.
Software Engineer supporting enterprise security platforms, building system integrations and applications, and enabling AI-driven security analytics

Responsibilities:
• Support and maintain enterprise corporate security platforms including: Access Control, Visitor Management Video Surveillance Systems, Alarm Monitoring Platforms, Risk Intelligence and Command Center systems
• Design, develop, enhance, and support software integrations between security systems, enterprise applications, and cloud services
• Develop and maintain applications, APIs, databases, automation scripts, and reporting solutions that improve security operations and business processes
• Support AI-driven security initiatives including video analytics, threat detection, automation, reporting, and operational intelligence solutions
• Troubleshoot application, server, database, and integration issues and coordinate resolution of production incidents affecting corporate security operations

Requirements:
• 1+ years of software development experience with a focus on backend systems, automation, or AI-enabled applications
• 1+ years of experience with Python building AI workflows, integrations, APIs, and automation services
• 1+ years of experience designing and implementing agentic workflows, including triggers, decision trees, state management, and multi-step orchestration patterns
• 1+ years of experience integrating enterprise systems and third-party services through REST APIs and event-driven architecture
• 1+ years of SQL skills (queries, joins, data modeling, and performance optimization)
• 1+ years of experience building, deploying, and supporting production solutions through CI/CD pipelines while following security best practices and mitigating operational risk

Preferred:
• Experience with Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI platforms such as Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar services
• Experience developing AI agents that utilize tools, memory, workflow orchestration, and human-in-the-loop decision processes
• Experience processing and analyzing unstructured data including emails, support tickets, documents, transcripts, and call recordings
• Familiarity with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases, semantic search, and prompt engineering concepts
• Experience working in regulated environments such as healthcare, security, financial services, or other compliance-driven industries
